footer.tagline: The professional references platform. All rights reserved.

hero.subheadline: Caché is the platform where professionals build trust. Gather validated references from your work environment and show what a CV cannot tell.

features.tagline: Unlike generic endorsements, Caché collects structured and actionable feedback on your true competencies.

item1.title: 360° Verification
item1.desc: Cross-referenced endorsements from former colleagues, managers, and clients to build an unbreakable profile.

item2.title: Culture Fit Match
item2.desc: Find companies that align not only with your skills, but also with your working values.

item3.title: Stand out from the CV
item3.desc: Demonstrate your real soft skills validated by professionals you have collaborated with.

skillsSection.title: The 5 Key Soft Skills
skillsSection.subtitle: Our structured and secure questionnaires evaluate the behavioral competencies most in demand in high-performance teams.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.desc: Active collaboration, fluid interpersonal communication, and contributing to a positive group climate.

selfConfidence.title: Self-Confidence
selfConfidence.desc: Confidence in decision-making, personal initiative, and professional assertiveness.

proactivity.title: Proactivity
proactivity.desc: Anticipating needs, drive when facing obstacles, and search for continuous improvement.

integrity.title: Integrity
integrity.desc: Responsibility, professional ethics, honesty, and fulfillment of agreements.

flexibility.title: Flexibility
flexibility.desc: Adaptability in the face of organizational changes, openness to new ideas, and rapid learning.

howItWorks.desc: The process is simple, transparent, and designed to extract maximum value from your professional network without causing inconvenience to your contacts.

step1.title: Create your Caché profile
step1.desc: Sign up and fill out your professional experience.

step2.title: Request Feedback
step2.desc: Send structured requests to your professional contacts.

step3.title: Increase your Value
step3.desc: Use your validated profile to stand out in selection processes.

trustProtocol.desc1: At Caché, we do not believe in empty reviews. Every reference received is processed by our Referrer Reliability Algorithm to verify its authenticity in a completely automated way.
trustProtocol.desc2: This incentivizes professionals to provide legitimate corporate emails and verifiable information, giving B2B recruiters an absolute guarantee against self-evaluations or falsified references.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.desc: Validate your real experience, stand out in interviews by showcasing previous references, and build a solid personal brand independent of the traditional CV.

recruiters.title: Recruiters & Companies
recruiters.desc: Reduce friction in hiring, verify references in a standardized way, and ensure cultural fit before hiring.

useCases.title: MiCaché Use Cases
useCases.desc: Discover how different profiles in the network get the most out of our platform.

case1.title: Active Candidate
case1.desc: Boost your value in the job market by attaching a link to your certified soft skills report to your traditional CV or job portal profile.

case2.title: Freelance & Consultant
case2.desc: Close new consulting contracts by demonstrating an immaculate reputation through audited feedback and a high corporate trust index.

case3.title: Recruiters & Headhunters
case3.desc: Directly access the complete profile in read mode, verify the authenticity of the direct manager's email, and optimize pre-selection decisions.

case4.title: HR & Managers
case4.desc: Standardize and automate the bureaucratic process of asking final candidates' former colleagues for references in just one click.

bottomCta.title: Your next job values your reputation
bottomCta.desc: Don't let your talent remain hidden behind a PDF. Join Caché today.

INTEGRITY.name: Integrity
